description: Real production joins (incident_match_log, semantic matcher, top_similarity < 0.90) labelled by hand. One row per distinct pair of texts; distancesM lists each decision that joined that pair. Label rule: same = the same physical fault fixable by one repair job; ambiguous = plausibly one root cause, excluded from headline figures. Labeller: assistant, 2026-10-14. Reviewed 2026-10-22 against a blind second labeller (gemini-3.8-flash, eval/results/production-joins-review-2026-10-22/): agreement 19/30, Cohen's kappa 0.45, no same/different flips; every disagreement was the second labeller choosing ambiguous. Three labels changed to ambiguous on review (p5, p12, p26), each noted in its reason. The texts are seed data from backend-spring/scripts/seed-dev-data.mjs, not residents.
